login.googleTerms: If you do not have an account yet, continuing with Google creates one. By doing so, you confirm you are 18 or older, agree to the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and confirm you have read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

signup.closedDescription: The experiment isn't accepting new public sign-ups right now. Thank you for your interest! If you received an invitation, you can still create your account with the e-mail it was sent to.
signup.closedInvited: You're joining through an invitation, so you can sign up as usual: just use the same e-mail address the invitation was sent to.

forgot.title: Recover password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a link to reset your password.
forgot.successDescription: If the address is registered, you will receive a link to reset your password.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.successDescription: Your password has been changed. You can continue now.
reset.noSession: The reset link has expired or is invalid.

google.unavailable: Google sign-in is not configured in this environment yet. Use the quick sign-up above.

errors.passwordTooShort: Password must have at least 8 characters.
errors.invalidCredentials: Incorrect email or password, or email not confirmed yet.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.providerUnavailable: This sign-in method is not available right now.
errors.oauth: We could not sign you in with the external provider. Please try again.
errors.callback: We could not complete authentication. Please sign in again.
errors.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.sessionRequired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.unknown: We could not complete the request. Try again in a moment.
errors.samePassword: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.experimentClosed: We couldn't create your account: sign-ups are paused for now and only invited people can join. If you received an invitation, use exactly the e-mail it was sent to.
errors.accountSuspended: This account is suspended. If you think this is a mistake, please contact the administration.
errors.fullNameInvalid: Enter your first and last name (letters only).
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a Brazilian mobile number with area code, e.g. (11) 91234-5678.
errors.emailExists: This email already has an account. Sign in with your password under “I already have a password” or with Google.
errors.signupUnavailable: Quick sign-up is unavailable right now. Try again later or continue with Google.

quick.title: Get in within seconds
quick.subtitle: Just your name, email and mobile number. No password to come up with: we create one for you.
quick.phoneHint: Brazilian mobile with area code. May start with +55.
quick.honeypot: Do not fill in this field
quick.terms: By continuing, you declare you are 18 or older, agree to the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and confirm you have read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
quick.noPassword: No email confirmation: you get in right away.

password.title: Your password
password.intro: Your account was created and you are signed in. Write down or copy this password: you will need it to sign in on another device.
password.copyFailed: Could not copy. Write the password down by hand.
password.storedNote: You can also look it up later in Profile › Account and privacy, and generate a new one there.
password.notStoredNote: Write it down now: at the moment the password cannot be looked up later in the app. If you forget it, use “Forgot my password” or sign in with Google.
password.resumeBody: You are signed in. If you did not write down your password, look it up in Profile › Account and privacy.
password.notSignedIn: Your account was created, but we could not sign you in automatically. Use “I already have a password” with your email and the password above.
